questions.stem: Regarding malignant otitis externa (MOE), which of the following statements are correct? i. The causative organism is always Pseudomonas aeruginosa. ii. The fissures of Santorini are implicated in spread of disease. iii. Cranial nerves IX, X, and XI are the most commonly affected cranial nerves. iv. Facial nerve involvement is an independent prognostic indicator. v. There is no difference in predisposition between type I and II diabetes.
